headline: The breakout clip in this batch has no spoken words.
headline_detail: It is an 18-second silent scroll through TikTok Shop skincare finds with prices on screen the entire time. Half a million views against a few thousand followers. A transcript-only pipeline would have missed it completely.
second: Reach and relevance barely overlap in this niche: the batch that is useful for ads mixes one pure viral visual with high-relevance UGC hooks and ingredient explainers. Only a few clips score well on both.

patterns.title: Show the price, say nothing
patterns.desc: Silent Shop scroll with prices legible end to end. No script, no edit polish, and it beat every talking head in raw reach.

patterns.title: Problem-first product gate
patterns.desc: "Stop buying X if Y" as the open. Filters the right buyer before the product appears. Strong for DTC skincare ads.

patterns.title: Same-frame before and after
patterns.desc: Identical lighting and camera across weeks. Proof over claims. Works for retinol, acne, barrier repair.

patterns.title: Hook library, not product pitch
patterns.desc: Creators teaching opening lines and UGC templates. Use the structure for your own Shop ads. That is the angle-research payoff.
